meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 它会让 Claude 先确认是否更新技能，再按固定流程制作短动态图形：判断需不需要搜素材，设计分镜与运动，用现成模块搭动画并自动检查，最终渲染成 MP4 或透明覆盖层视频，并保留项目文件。
howto.when: 当需求是短小、无旁白的动态短视频（文字动效/图表动画/Logo展示，通常10秒内）时触发；更长/有旁白/多场景转 /general-video，不确定交给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用「效率加倍」四个字做一个 5 秒的文字弹跳动画，导出 MP4。
say.note: 它会先确认是否更新技能，再进入文字动画流程。

say.text: 把 82% 做成环形进度倒计时的动效，透明背景。
say.note: 它按统计数字类别生成圆环动画，可输出透明视频。

say.text: 打开我发的网页链接，模拟滚动和点击，做成 8 秒展示动画。
say.note: 它会先搜索网页素材，再做成网页/UI 动效。

howto.what_en: Makes Claude confirm a skill update, then plan, optionally source assets, design, build from reusable blocks, verify, and render to MP4 or transparent overlay, leaving local project files.
howto.when_en: For short, design-led, unnarrated motion graphics (e.g. kinetic type, chart animation, logo reveal; usually 10s or less). Longer/narrated/multi-scene use /general-video; ambiguous /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a 5s bouncing text animation for 'Double Efficiency' and export as MP4.
say_en.note: It confirms skill update first, then renders the animation.

say_en.text: Turn 82% into a looping ring/count-up animation with transparent background.
say_en.note: It creates the stat animation for a transparent export.

say_en.text: Simulate scroll and click on the webpage link I sent; make an 8s demo.
say_en.note: It sources the page assets, then builds a UI animation.
